home.headline: The <hl>Healthcare ERP</hl> that automates what nobody wants to do.
home.subtitle: For psychologists, psychoanalysts, therapists and clinics who want to get back to caring for people, not spreadsheets. Scheduling, Pix, invoicing, WhatsApp and predictive AI in one system.
home.fineprint: 15-day free trial · No credit card · Cancel anytime

schedule.title: Scheduling with Meet/Zoom
schedule.desc: Automatic WhatsApp confirmations, 24h/2h reminders, encrypted telehealth link.

finance.title: Complete financial automation
finance.desc: Pix Automático, payment links, recurring billing, and overdue recovery through payment reminders.

tax.title: Frictionless tax filing
tax.desc: NFS-e by municipality, digital receipts and Receita Saúde 2025 issued in 1 click.

saluttin.title: Saluttin - clinical + predictive AI
saluttin.desc: Session summaries in seconds, financial insights ("your revenue dropped 12%") and churn detection.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business API
whatsapp.desc: 100% of professionals use WhatsApp - Salutti turns it into an official channel with approved templates.

lgpd.title: LGPD by design
lgpd.desc: Sensitive data mapping, consent management, audit log and support for the 9 data subject rights.

noCrp.title: No CRP? No problem.
noCrp.desc: Psychoanalysts and therapists with non-regulated training are welcome - unlike the competition.

erp.title: An ERP, not a "pretty calendar".
erp.desc: Focused on the admin work that takes 2 to 20 hours of a professional’s week.

offline.title: Optional offline-first
offline.desc: For UBS (public health units) and clinics with unstable infrastructure (Kris Fellipe / Turvânia case).

pay.title: Payment · {workspace}
pay.confirmed: Payment confirmed. Your receipt is on its way.

portal.intro: Here you can see your sessions and payments, and log how you’re feeling on your daily card.
portal.noPending: No pending payments. You’re all set.
portal.dailyCardDescription: Log your mood, sleep and anxiety. Your care provider follows along in your record.

estetica.metaDescription: Scheduling, records, photos with consent, inventory with lot and expiry tracking, and finance for aesthetics professionals.
estetica.headline: Your aesthetics practice, <hl>organized</hl>.
estetica.subtitle: Scheduling, records and photos with consent, inventory with lot and expiry traced to each patient, and finance in one place.
estetica.fineprint: 15 days free · No card · Cancel anytime

stock.title: Inventory with traceability
stock.desc: Receive stock by lot and expiry, deduct it automatically at each visit, and answer “who received lot X”.

consent.title: Consent form per procedure
consent.desc: Each procedure has its own consent form, with the patient's acceptance recorded before the visit.

followUp.title: Follow-up reminder
followUp.desc: Each procedure's follow-up interval suggests the next session, like a toxin touch-up.

schedule.title: Schedule and WhatsApp
schedule.desc: Sessions, confirmations and reminders over WhatsApp, with each patient's history at hand.

records.title: Records and photos with consent
records.desc: Intake, progress notes and before-and-after photos. Sharing only with the patient's separate permission.

finance.title: Finance
finance.desc: Pix payments, receipts, supply cost and margin for every visit.

trace.title: Lot linked to the patient
trace.desc: Product, lot, expiry and amount used are recorded in the session, supporting ANVISA traceability.

fefo.title: Automatic deduction
fefo.desc: When you log a visit, the system suggests the lot that expires first and deducts it from inventory.

alerts.title: Alerts that prevent waste
alerts.desc: Low stock, upcoming expiry and expired open vials show up before they become a problem.

estetica.disclaimer: Salutti Estética organizes your schedule, records and inventory. It does not promise procedure results: the clinical call stays with you.
estetica.footer: Salutti Estética · Practice management for aesthetics professionals ·
